lyrics.original:
सुन्दर सुन्दर विनायक
शुभ मंगल दायक विनायक
विघ्न कोटि हर विमल गजानन
सकल विघ्न हर साई गजानन
ईश्वरी नन्दन पार्थी गजानन
lyrics.transliteration:
Sundara Sundara Vinayaka
Shubha Mangala Dayaka Vinayaka
Vighna Koti Hara Vimala Gajanana
Sakala Vighna Hara Sai Gajanana
Eshwari Nandana Parthi Gajanana
lyrics.translation: Victory to Lord Ganesha who is very beautiful, who bestows everything good and auspicious. He is the remover of millions of obstacles that come in our way. He is the elephant-faced son of Parvathi and is verily Lord Sai who resides in Parthi.

lyrics.original:
दशरथ नन्दन राम दया सागर राम
रघुकुल तिलक राम सत्य साई श्री परन्धाम
अहल्योद्धारक राम शाप विमोचन राम
शिर्डी पुरीश राम पुट्टपर्ती पुरी परन्धाम
lyrics.transliteration:
Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama
Raghukula Tilaka Rama Sathya Sai Sri Parandhama
Ahalyodharaka Rama Shaapa Vimochana Rama
Shirdi Pureesha Rama Puttaparthi Puri Parandhama
lyrics.translation: Glory to Thee, O Lord Rama, the darling son of King Dasharatha, You are an ocean of compassion and the Crown Jewel of the Raghu Dynasty. You are the saviour of Ahalya from the curse that had turned her into a stone. You are Lord Sathya Sai, the indweller of hearts, with Shirdi and Parthi as Your supreme abodes.

lines.original: दशरथ नन्दन राम दया सागर राम
lines.transliteration: Dasharatha Nandana Rama Daya Sagara Rama

lines.original: रघुकुल तिलक राम सत्य साई श्री परन्धाम
lines.transliteration: Raghukula Tilaka Rama Sathya Sai Sri Parandhama

lines.original: शिर्डी पुरीश राम पुट्टपर्ती पुरी परन्धाम
lines.transliteration: Shirdi Pureesha Rama Puttaparthi Puri Parandhama

lyrics.original:
सत्य साई पदाम्बुजम् भजोरे मनसा निरन्तरम्
परम पवित्रम् पावन चरणम्
कलिमल दहनम् श्री गुरु चरणम्
भव भय नाशन दुरित निवारण
पार्थी पुरीश्वर पंकज चरणम्
lyrics.transliteration:
Sathya Sai Padambujam Bhajorey Manasa Nirantharam
Parama Pavitram Pavana Charanam
Kalimala Dahanam Sri Guru Charanam
Bhava Bhaya Nashana Duritha Nivarana
Parthi Pureeshwara Pankaja Charanam
lyrics.translation: Meditate incessantly upon the most holy and auspicious Lotus Feet of Lord Sathya Sai. His feet are supremely pure and sacred. They burn away the sins of this Kali age. They destroy the fear of worldly existence and remove all afflictions. Worship the lotus feet of the Lord of Parthi.

lines.original: सत्य साई पदाम्बुजम् भजोरे मनसा निरन्तरम्
lines.transliteration: Sathya Sai Padambujam Bhajorey Manasa Nirantharam

lyrics.original:
कोटि प्रणाम शत कोटि प्रणाम
हे दीन नाथ साई राम
तुम हो भक्तों के युग अवतार
तुम हो आनन्द नन्द के लाल
पार्थी पुरी के साई गोपाल
lyrics.transliteration:
Koti Pranam Shata Koti Pranam
Hey Deena Natha Sai Ram
Tum Ho Bhakthon Ke Yuga Avatar
Tum Ho Ananda Nanda Ke Lal
Parthi Puri Ke Sai Gopal
lyrics.translation: Many repeated salutations to You Lord Sai, the refuge of the forlorn. You are the incarnation of our age, born for the devotees. You are the son of Nanda, the blissful one. You are Sai Gopala residing at Parthi.

lines.original: तुम हो भक्तों के युग अवतार
lines.transliteration: Tum Ho Bhakthon Ke Yuga Avatar

lines.original: तुम हो आनन्द नन्द के लाल
lines.transliteration: Tum Ho Ananda Nanda Ke Lal

lyrics.original:
मनसा भजोरे गुरु चरणम्
दुस्तर भव सागर तरणम्
गुरु महाराज गुरु जय जय
साई नाथ गुरु जय जय
ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय
अरुणाचल शिव अरुणाचल शिव
lyrics.transliteration:
Manasa Bhajorey Guru Charanam
Dusthara Bhava Sagara Tharanam
Guru Maharaj Guru Jai Jai
Sai Natha Guru Jai Jai
Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya
Arunachala Shiva Arunachala Shiva
lyrics.translation: O mind, worship at the feet of the Guru. Take refuge under His feet which enables us to cross the unconquerable ocean of life. Victory to the great Guru, victory to Lord Sai Natha. Chant Om Namah Shivaya, salutations to the Lord of Arunachala.

lines.original: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय
lines.transliteration: Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya

lyrics.original:
अम्बा मन्द हास वदनी मनोहारी साई जगत् जननी
माता माता माता जगत् जननी
जगत् जननी शुभ कारिणी
साई जगन्माता
सत्य साई जगन्माता
lyrics.transliteration:
Amba Manda Haasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani
Mata Mata Mata Jagat Janani
Jagat Janani Shubha Karini
Sai Jaganmata
Sathya Sai Jaganmata
lyrics.translation: Worship the auspicious Mother of the Universe, Mother Sai who has an enchanting face with a charming smile. She is the Mother of the world, the bestower of auspiciousness. Sathya Sai is the Mother of the entire creation.

lines.original: अम्बा मन्द हास वदनी मनोहारी साई जगत् जननी
lines.transliteration: Amba Manda Haasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani

lyrics.original:
पवन सुत हनुमान की जय
सीता पति रामचन्द्र की जय
पराक्रम अंजनेय की जय
पार्थी पुरी साई नाथ की जय
lyrics.transliteration:
Pavana Sutha Hanuman Ki Jai
Sita Pathi Ramachandra Ki Jai
Parakrama Anjaneya Ki Jai
Parthi Puri Sai Nath Ki Jai
lyrics.translation: Victory to Hanuman, the son of the wind God. Victory to the chosen Lord of Sita, Lord Ramachandra. Victory to the mighty son of Anjana Devi. Victory to the Lord of Parthi, Sai Nath.

lines.original: पार्थी पुरी साई नाथ की जय
lines.transliteration: Parthi Puri Sai Nath Ki Jai

lyrics.original:
अयोध्या विहारी श्री राम राम राम
द्वारका विहारी श्री कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण
सप्तगिरि विहारी गोविन्द गोविन्द
निज भक्त हृदय विहारी श्री साई नाथ देव
lyrics.transliteration:
Ayodhya Vihari Sri Rama Rama Rama
Dwaraka Vihari Sri Krishna Krishna Krishna
Saptagiri Vihari Govinda Govinda
Nija Bhaktha Hrudaya Vihari Sri Sai Natha Deva
lyrics.translation: This bhajan celebrates the divine across sacred locations. It invokes Lord Rama who resides in Ayodhya, Lord Krishna in Dwaraka, and Lord Govinda in the seven hills (Tirumala). It culminates in honoring Sai as the divine Lord who dwells within the hearts of devoted ones.

lines.original: अयोध्या विहारी श्री राम राम राम
lines.transliteration: Ayodhya Vihari Sri Rama Rama Rama

lines.original: द्वारका विहारी श्री कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण
lines.transliteration: Dwaraka Vihari Sri Krishna Krishna Krishna

lines.original: निज भक्त हृदय विहारी श्री साई नाथ देव
lines.transliteration: Nija Bhaktha Hrudaya Vihari Sri Sai Natha Deva

lyrics.original:
जगत्पते हरि साई गोपाला
जगदोद्धार साई नन्दलाला
मथुराधिपते कृष्ण गोपाला
मधुर मधुर हे गान विलोल
जगदोद्धार साई नन्दलाला
साई नन्दलाला जय जय गोपाला
lyrics.transliteration:
Jagatpathey Hari Sai Gopala
Jagadodhara Sai Nandalala
Mathuradhipathey Krishna Gopala
Madhura Madhura Hey Gaana Vilola
Jagadodhara Sai Nandalala
Sai Nandalala Jai Jai Gopala
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Gopala (Krishna), the Lord and sustainer of the Universe. Victory to Lord Krishna, the King of Mathura, the patron of sweet music and the son of Nanda. Victory to Lord Sai who is verily Lord Krishna.

lyrics.original:
ईश्वराम्बा प्रिय नन्दन साई जय जग वन्दन
रत्नाकर कुल भूषण राजीव नयन नारायण
नारायण हरि नारायण नारायण साई नारायण
नारायण हरि नारायण
lyrics.transliteration:
Eshwaramba Priya Nandana Sai Jaya Jaga Vandana
Ratnakara Kula Bhooshana Rajeeva Nayana Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana Narayana Sai Narayana
Narayana Hari Narayana
lyrics.translation: O Lord Sai, You are the beloved son of Mother Eshwaramba. You are worshipped by the whole world. You are the jewel of the Ratnakara clan, with eyes as beautiful as the lotus. O Lord Sai, You are verily Lord Hari Narayana.

lines.original: ईश्वराम्बा प्रिय नन्दन साई जय जग वन्दन
lines.transliteration: Eshwaramba Priya Nandana Sai Jaya Jaga Vandana

lines.original: रत्नाकर कुल भूषण राजीव नयन नारायण
lines.transliteration: Ratnakara Kula Bhooshana Rajeeva Nayana Narayana

lines.original: नारायण हरि नारायण नारायण साई नारायण
lines.transliteration: Narayana Hari Narayana Narayana Sai Narayana

lyrics.original:
अल्लाह भजो मौलाह भजो हे अल्लाह साई भगवान
राम भजो हे कृष्ण भजो हे राम कृष्ण भगवान
नानक भजो गौतम भजो हे बुद्ध साई भगवान
येसु भजो जरथुस्त्र भजो हे महावीर भगवान
साई भजो शिर्डी साई भजो हे शिर्डी साई भगवान
सत्य भजो सत्य साई भजो हे सत्य साई भगवान
lyrics.transliteration:
Allah Bhajo Maulah Bhajo Hey Allah Sai Bhagawan
Ram Bhajo Hey Krishna Bhajo Hey Rama Krishna Bhagawan
Nanak Bhajo Gautam Bhajo Hey Buddha Sai Bhagawan
Yesu Bhajo Zohrashtra Bhajo Hey Mahavir Bhagawan
Sai Bhajo Shirdi Sai Bhajo Hey Shirdi Sai Bhagawan
Sathya Bhajo Sathya Sai Bhajo Hey Sathya Sai Bhagawan
lyrics.translation: Chant the divine names of the Lord across all faiths — Allah, Rama, Krishna, Guru Nanak, Buddha, Zoroaster, Mahavir, Shirdi Sai and Sathya Sai. The song celebrates the universal spirituality that unites all faith traditions in worship of the one Divine.

lines.original: येसु भजो जरथुस्त्र भजो हे महावीर भगवान
lines.transliteration: Yesu Bhajo Zohrashtra Bhajo Hey Mahavir Bhagawan

lyrics.original:
भोला भण्डारी बाबा शिव शिव शिव साई बाबा
अनाथ रक्षक दीन दयाला पतित पावन साई बाबा
योगेश्वर साई मुरारी योगेश्वर हे त्रिपुरारी
नित्यानन्द ब्रह्मानन्द प्रेमानन्द साई बाबा
lyrics.transliteration:
Bhola Bhandari Baba Shiva Shiva Shiva Sai Baba
Anatha Rakshaka Deena Dayala Patitha Pavana Sai Baba
Yogeshwara Sai Murari Yogeshwara Hey Tripurari
Nithyananda Brahmananda Premananda Sai Baba
lyrics.translation: Lord Sai Baba, easily pleased and a treasure of mercy and prosperity, is the protector of orphans and the refuge of the destitute. He is honored as the Lord of Yogis, as Sai Murari (Krishna), and as Tripurari (Shiva), the embodiment of eternal bliss and divine love.

lines.original: भोला भण्डारी बाबा शिव शिव शिव साई बाबा
lines.transliteration: Bhola Bhandari Baba Shiva Shiva Shiva Sai Baba

lines.original: अनाथ रक्षक दीन दयाला पतित पावन साई बाबा
lines.transliteration: Anatha Rakshaka Deena Dayala Patitha Pavana Sai Baba

lines.original: योगेश्वर साई मुरारी योगेश्वर हे त्रिपुरारी
lines.transliteration: Yogeshwara Sai Murari Yogeshwara Hey Tripurari

lyrics.original:
साई नाथ दीन नाथ ब्रह्म रूप सद्गुरु
निराकार हे आकार सत्य साई सद्गुरु
ओंकार सद्गुरु निर्विकार सद्गुरु
निर्विकार सद्गुरु ओंकार सद्गुरु
माता पिता सद्गुरु सकल तुम ही सद्गुरु
lyrics.transliteration:
Sai Natha Deena Natha Brahma Roopa Sadguru
Nirakara Hey Akara Sathya Sai Sadguru
Omkara Sadguru Nirvikara Sadguru
Nirvikara Sadguru Omkara Sadguru
Mata Pitha Sadguru Sakala Tum Hi Sadguru
lyrics.translation: This devotional hymn honors Sai as the Supreme Guru, protector of the weak and the downtrodden. It celebrates Sai's nature as both formless and embodied in divine form, references the primordial sound 'Om,' and concludes by acknowledging Sai as mother, father and our everything.

lines.original: साई नाथ दीन नाथ ब्रह्म रूप सद्गुरु
lines.transliteration: Sai Natha Deena Natha Brahma Roopa Sadguru

lines.original: निराकार हे आकार सत्य साई सद्गुरु
lines.transliteration: Nirakara Hey Akara Sathya Sai Sadguru

lines.original: माता पिता सद्गुरु सकल तुम ही सद्गुरु
lines.transliteration: Mata Pitha Sadguru Sakala Tum Hi Sadguru

lyrics.original:
गरुड वाहन नारायण
हे शेष शयन नारायण
श्री लक्ष्मी रमण नारायण
हरि ॐ हरि ॐ नारायण
lyrics.transliteration:
Garuda Vahana Narayana
Hey Shesha Shayana Narayana
Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
Hari Om Hari Om Narayana
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Narayana, who is the beloved of His consort Goddess Lakshmi, whose vehicle is Garuda, who sleeps on the serpent Adi Sesha, and who is also known as Hari.

lyrics.original:
गंगा जटाधर गौरी शंकर गिरिजा मनो रमण
जय मृत्युंजय महादेव महेश्वर मंगल शुभ चरण
नन्दि वाहन नाग भूषण
निरुपम गुण सदन
नटन मनोहर नीलकंठ साई
नीरज दल नयन
lyrics.transliteration:
Ganga Jatadhara Gowri Shankara Girija Mano Ramana
Jaya Mruthyunjaya Mahadeva Maheshwara Mangala Shubha Charana
Nandi Vahana Naga Bhooshana
Nirupama Guna Sadana
Natana Manohara Neelakanta Sai
Neeraja Dala Nayana
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Shiva, who bears the sacred Ganges in his matted hair and is the consort of Goddess Girija. Victory to the conqueror of death, the great Lord Maheshwara whose feet bestow auspiciousness. He rides the bull Nandi, is adorned with serpents, and is an embodiment of unparalleled virtues — the enchanting cosmic dancer with a blue throat, identified with Sai.

lines.original: गंगा जटाधर गौरी शंकर गिरिजा मनो रमण
lines.transliteration: Ganga Jatadhara Gowri Shankara Girija Mano Ramana

lines.original: जय मृत्युंजय महादेव महेश्वर मंगल शुभ चरण
lines.transliteration: Jaya Mruthyunjaya Mahadeva Maheshwara Mangala Shubha Charana

lyrics.original:
गोविन्द बोलो गोपाल बोलो
राम राम बोलो हरि नाम बोलो
अल्लाह साई येसु नानक
जरथुस्त्र महावीर बुद्ध नाम बोलो
ये नाम सारे हैं जीवन सहारे
परमानन्द के ये खोलते हैं द्वारे
जो नाम चाहो वो नाम बोलो
प्रेम से बोलो भाव से बोलो
lyrics.transliteration:
Govinda Bolo Gopala Bolo
Ram Ram Bolo Hari Naam Bolo
Allah Sai Yesu Nanak
Zohrashtra Mahavira Buddha Naam Bolo
Yeh Naam Saarey Hai Jeevan Saharey
Paramananda Ke Yeh Kholtey Hai Dwarey
Jo Naam Chaho Woh Naam Bolo
Prem Se Bolo Bhaav Se Bolo
lyrics.translation: Chant the sacred names — Govinda, Gopala, Rama, Hari, Allah, Sai, Yesu, Nanak, Zoroaster, Mahavira and Buddha. These names sustain life's journey and open doors to supreme bliss. Choose whichever name resonates with you and recite it with love and devotion.

lines.original: राम राम बोलो हरि नाम बोलो
lines.transliteration: Ram Ram Bolo Hari Naam Bolo

lines.original: ये नाम सारे हैं जीवन सहारे
lines.transliteration: Yeh Naam Saarey Hai Jeevan Saharey

lines.original: जो नाम चाहो वो नाम बोलो
lines.transliteration: Jo Naam Chaho Woh Naam Bolo

lyrics.original:
श्रीनिवास वेङ्कटेश श्रित जन परिपाल सायीश
तिरुमल गिरि वास गोविन्द
गरुड वाहन गोविन्द गोविन्द
गोविन्द गोविन्द श्रीनिवास गोविन्द
गोविन्द गोविन्द शिर्डी वास गोविन्द
गोविन्द गोविन्द पार्थी वास गोविन्द
lyrics.transliteration:
Srinivasa Venkatesha Shritha Jana Paripala Sayeesha
Tirumala Giri Vasa Govinda
Garuda Vahana Govinda Govinda
Govinda Govinda Srinivasa Govinda
Govinda Govinda Shirdi Vasa Govinda
Govinda Govinda Parthi Vasa Govinda
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Srinivasa, Lord Venkatesha (names of Lord Vishnu) and Lord Sayeesha who protects all those who have surrendered to Him. Praise to Lord Govinda who resides in the Tirumala hills, who rides the eagle Garuda, and who manifests in Shirdi and Parthi.

lines.original: श्रीनिवास वेङ्कटेश श्रित जन परिपाल सायीश
lines.transliteration: Srinivasa Venkatesha Shritha Jana Paripala Sayeesha

lyrics.original:
भजरे राम चरण सततं भजरे
भजरे जानकी जीवन रामम्
भजरे रामम् भद्राचल रामम्
भजरे पावन तारक नामम्
भजरे श्री राम रामेति रामम्
lyrics.transliteration:
Bhajarey Rama Charan Satatam Bhajarey
Bhajarey Janaki Jeevana Ramam
Bhajarey Ramam Bhadrachala Ramam
Bhajarey Pavana Taraka Naamam
Bhajarey Sri Rama Ramethi Ramam
lyrics.translation: Constantly chant and meditate upon the Lotus Feet of Lord Rama. Pray to Lord Rama, the very life of Janaki and the resident of Bhadrachala. Chant His sacred name that purifies and ferries us across the ocean of worldly existence.

lyrics.original:
गिरिधर गोविन्द गोपाल घन श्याम नन्दलाल
मन मोहन मधुसूदन हे माधव
दामोदर जनार्दन मुरलीधर मन मोहन
नमो साई नारायणाय नमो सत्य नारायणाय
lyrics.transliteration:
Giridhara Govinda Gopala Ghana Shyama Nandalala
Mana Mohana Madhusudhana Hey Madhava
Damodara Janardhana Muralidhara Mana Mohana
Namo Sai Narayanaya Namo Sathya Narayanaya
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Krishna — the lifter of Govardhana mountain (Giridhara), the cowherd (Govinda), protector of cows (Gopala), the dark-hued one (Ghana Shyama), beloved son of Nanda. He is the enchanting one (Mana Mohana), slayer of the demon Madhu (Madhusudhana), the bearer of the flute (Muralidhara), and protector of devotees (Janardhana). Salutations to Sai who is verily Narayana, the embodiment of divine truth.

lines.original: गिरिधर गोविन्द गोपाल घन श्याम नन्दलाल
lines.transliteration: Giridhara Govinda Gopala Ghana Shyama Nandalala

lines.original: नमो साई नारायणाय नमो सत्य नारायणाय
lines.transliteration: Namo Sai Narayanaya Namo Sathya Narayanaya

lyrics.original:
प्रेममयी साई मां ज्ञानमयी साई मां
जय मां जय मां जय मां
शिव शक्ति रूपिणी साई मां
सदानन्द रूपिणी साई मां
परब्रह्म रूपिणी साई मां
तुम ही मोक्ष प्रदायिनी मां
lyrics.transliteration:
Premamayi Sai Ma Gnanamayi Sai Ma
Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Ma
Shiva Shakthi Roopini Sai Ma
Sadananda Roopini Sai Ma
Parabrahma Roopini Sai Ma
Tum Hi Moksha Pradayini Ma
lyrics.translation: Victory to Mother Sai — embodiment of love and wisdom, ever in a state of bliss. You are Shiva and Shakti united in one form, the supreme consciousness incarnate, and the bestower of liberation upon all who surrender to You.

lines.original: प्रेममयी साई मां ज्ञानमयी साई मां
lines.transliteration: Premamayi Sai Ma Gnanamayi Sai Ma

lines.original: जय मां जय मां जय मां
lines.transliteration: Jaya Ma Jaya Ma Jaya Ma

lyrics.original:
प्रणमामि श्री दुर्गे साई नारायणी
जय जगदम्बे देवी भवानी
जय महिषासुर संहारिणी महामाया दुख हारिणी
lyrics.transliteration:
Pranamami Sri Durge Sai Narayani
Jaya Jagadambe Devi Bhavani
Jaya Mahishasura Samhaarini Mahamaya Dukha Haarini
lyrics.translation: We offer our obeisance to You, Mother Durga — Sister of Vishnu, Mother of the Universe, and Devi Bhavani. Glory to the destroyer of the demon Mahishasura (the ego), the bearer of the great cosmic illusion, and the remover of all sorrow.

lines.original: जय महिषासुर संहारिणी महामाया दुख हारिणी
lines.transliteration: Jaya Mahishasura Samhaarini Mahamaya Dukha Haarini

lyrics.original:
प्रेम ईश्वर है ईश्वर प्रेम है
हर धड़कन में साई समा है ईश्वर प्रेम है
राम रहीम कृष्ण करीम
जरथुस्त्र येसु नानक
कोई भी नाम जपोरे मनुवा ईश्वर प्रेम है
lyrics.transliteration:
Prem Eshwar Hai Eshwar Prem Hai
Har Dhadkan Mey Sai Sama Hai Eshwar Prem Hai
Ram Rahim Krishna Karim
Zohrashtra Yesu Nanak
Koi Bhi Naam Japorey Manuva Eshwar Prem Hai

(Japanese verse)
Ai wa Kami, Kami wa Ai
Sai wa Ibuki, Kami wa Ai
Namu Amida, Iesu Sai
Amaterasu, Kannon Sai
Ikanaru Mina wo Tonaete mo, Kami wa Ai
lyrics.translation: God is Love and Love is God. Sai is the indweller of every heartbeat, reminding us that God is Love. Worship any divine name — Rama, Rahim, Krishna, Karim, Zoroaster, Jesus or Nanak — for all names and forms are love and only love.

lines.original: प्रेम ईश्वर है ईश्वर प्रेम है
lines.transliteration: Prem Eshwar Hai Eshwar Prem Hai

lyrics.original:
साई बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
शिर्डी बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
पार्थी बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
lyrics.transliteration:
Sai Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
Shirdi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
Parthi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam
lyrics.translation: The nectarine words of wisdom and the melodies that flow from Sai Baba confer infinite supreme bliss. Sai Baba's song is sweet and gives bliss — the Lord of Shirdi and the Lord of Parthi are one and the same, the embodiment of nectar-sweet joy.

lines.original: साई बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
lines.transliteration: Sai Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam

lines.original: शिर्डी बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
lines.transliteration: Shirdi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam

lines.original: पार्थी बाबा गीता सुधा मधुरम मधुरम आनन्दम
lines.transliteration: Parthi Baba Geeta Sudha Madhuram Madhuram Anandam

lyrics.original:
चित्त चोर यशोदा के बाल
नवनीत चोर गोपाल
गोपाल गोपाल गोपाल गोवर्धनधर गोपाल
lyrics.transliteration:
Chitha Chora Yashoda Ke Bal
Navaneetha Chora Gopal
Gopal Gopal Gopal Govardhanadhara Gopal
lyrics.translation: O Lord Gopala, the beloved Prince of Mother Yashoda — captivator of devotees' hearts and stealer of butter from the Gopis. Chant the name of Govardhanadhara Gopal who held aloft the Govardhana mountain to shelter the villagers from torrential rain.

lyrics.original:
गुरु महिमा गाओ सद्गुरु साई अनन्त गुरु
ब्रह्मानन्द आनन्द गुरु
सर्व धर्म सत्य साई गुरु
साई गुरु सत्य साई गुरु
गुरु के वाणी गाओ
lyrics.transliteration:
Guru Mahima Gao Sadguru Sai Anantha Guru
Brahmananda Ananda Guru
Sarva Dharma Sathya Sai Guru
Sai Guru Sathya Sai Guru
Guru Ke Vani Gao
lyrics.translation: Sing about the greatness of the eternal, universal and ever-blissful teacher, Sathya Sai who loves all religions. He is the truth, knowledge and bliss.

lines.original: गुरु महिमा गाओ सद्गुरु साई अनन्त गुरु
lines.transliteration: Guru Mahima Gao Sadguru Sai Anantha Guru

title: Veera Dheera Shoora Hanuman Ki Jai

lyrics.original:
वीर धीर शूर हनुमान की जय
पवन पुत्र अंजनेय हनुमान की जय
सदा राम नाम जपत हनुमान की जय
राम राम राम राम राम राम राम राम
सीता शोक नाश कारण हनुमान की जय
lyrics.transliteration:
Veera Dheera Shoora Hanuman Ki Jai
Pavana Putra Anjaneya Hanuman Ki Jai
Sada Rama Naama Japata Hanuman Ki Jai
Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Rama Ram
Sita Shoka Nasha Kaarana Hanuman Ki Jai
lyrics.translation: Victory to Lord Hanuman, the one of valor, courage, strength, son of Pavan (the wind god) and Anjana Devi. Victory to the one who chants Lord Rama's name incessantly and who is responsible for the removal of Mother Sita's sorrow.

lines.original: वीर धीर शूर हनुमान की जय
lines.transliteration: Veera Dheera Shoora Hanuman Ki Jai

lines.original: पवन पुत्र अंजनेय हनुमान की जय
lines.transliteration: Pavana Putra Anjaneya Hanuman Ki Jai

lines.original: सदा राम नाम जपत हनुमान की जय
lines.transliteration: Sada Rama Naama Japata Hanuman Ki Jai

lines.original: सीता शोक नाश कारण हनुमान की जय
lines.transliteration: Sita Shoka Nasha Kaarana Hanuman Ki Jai

lyrics.original:
हर शिव शंकर शशांक शेखर
हर भम् हर भम् भम् भम् बोलो
भव भयंकर गिरिजा शंकर
धिमि धिमि धिमि थक नर्तन केलो
lyrics.transliteration:
Hara Shiva Shankara Shashankha Shekara
Hara Bham Hara Bham Bham Bham Bolo
Bhava Bhayankara Girija Shankara
Dhimi Dhimi Dhimi Thaka Narthana Kelo
lyrics.translation: Chant the name of Lord Shiva, dancing to the rhythm of drums. Shankara, Lord of Girija, destroys the fear of the cycle of birth and death.

lines.original: हर भम् हर भम् भम् भम् बोलो
lines.transliteration: Hara Bham Hara Bham Bham Bham Bolo

lines.original: धिमि धिमि धिमि थक नर्तन केलो
lines.transliteration: Dhimi Dhimi Dhimi Thaka Narthana Kelo

lyrics.original:
श्रीकरी कृपाकरी क्षेमंकरी सायीश्वरी
शंकरी अभयंकरी शुभंकरी सायीश्वरी
ताण्डवकेलि प्रियकरी भैरवी प्रलयंकरी
सर्वेश्वरी सुन्दरी दयाकरी महेश्वरी
lyrics.transliteration:
Srikari Krupakari Kshemankari Sayeeshwari
Shankari Abhayankari Shubhankari Sayeeshwari
Tandavakeli Priyakari Bhairavi Pralayankari
Sarveshwari Sundari Dayakari Maheshwari
lyrics.translation: Glory be to the beautiful, compassionate and all pervading goddess Parvathi, the consort of Shankara (Shiva), the one who bestows auspiciousness, who looks after the welfare of devotees, who bestows fearlessness and who is fond of the 'Tandava' dance.

lyrics.original:
लम्बोदर गणनाथ गजानन पार्वती नन्दन शुभानन
पशुपति तनय सिद्धि विनायक
प्रणवाकार शम्भो नन्दन
पार्थी पुरीश पाहि गजानन
हे शिव नन्दन शुभानन
lyrics.transliteration:
Lambodhara Gananatha Gajanana Parvathi Nandana Shubhanana
Pashupathi Tanaya Siddhi Vinayaka
Pranavakaara Shambho Nandana
Parthi Pureesha Paahi Gajanana
Hey Shiva Nandana Shubhanana
lyrics.translation: Protect me Lord Ganesha, the Lord of Ganaas, who has an elephant head and is the big bellied son of Mother Parvathi and Lord Shiva. You are the one who embodies the sacred Om and who is verily Sai, the Lord of Parthi.

lines.original: लम्बोदर गणनाथ गजानन पार्वती नन्दन शुभानन
lines.transliteration: Lambodhara Gananatha Gajanana Parvathi Nandana Shubhanana

lyrics.original:
भगवान भगवान पतित पावन राम
दया करो दया करो दया करो भगवान
दीन दयालु परम कृपालु रक्षा करो भगवान
साई कृपा करो भगवान
lyrics.transliteration:
Bhagawan Bhagawan Patitha Pavana Ram
Daya Karo Daya Karo Daya Karo Bhagawan
Deena Dayalu Parama Krupalu Raksha Karo Bhagawan
Sai Krupa Karo Bhagawan
lyrics.translation: O Lord Sai, chanting Your name purifies the downtrodden. O the ever merciful and compassionate Lord, please shower Your grace and protect us.

lines.original: दया करो दया करो दया करो भगवान
lines.transliteration: Daya Karo Daya Karo Daya Karo Bhagawan

lines.original: दीन दयालु परम कृपालु रक्षा करो भगवान
lines.transliteration: Deena Dayalu Parama Krupalu Raksha Karo Bhagawan

lyrics.original:
रघुकुल भूषण राजीव नयन
ईश्वराम्बा नन्दन सत्य साई राम
जानकी वल्लभ लावण्य राम
निरुपम सुन्दर सुगुणाभि राम
प्रशान्ति निलय पावन नाम
जय जय राम प्रभु साई राम
lyrics.transliteration:
Raghukula Bhooshana Rajeeva Nayana
Eshwaramba Nandana Sathya Sai Rama
Janaki Vallabha Lavanya Rama
Nirupama Sundara Sugunabhi Rama
Prashanthi Nilaya Pavana Naama
Jaya Jaya Rama Prabhu Sai Rama
lyrics.translation: Glory to the jewel of the Raghu dynasty, the lotus-eyed Lord Rama. He is none other than the darling son of Mother Eshwaramba, Lord Sathya Sai. The beloved of Janaki (Sita), the exquisitely handsome Lord Rama, is beautifully-complexioned and the most virtuous. Victory to Lord Rama, who is verily our Lord Sai Rama, of the Holy abode, Prashanthi Nilayam.

lines.original: जय जय राम प्रभु साई राम
lines.transliteration: Jaya Jaya Rama Prabhu Sai Rama

lyrics.original:
करुणा सागर हे नन्दलाला
मुरली मनोहर श्याम गोपाला
गिरिधर नागर साई गोपाला
मीरा के प्रभु श्याम गोपाला
lyrics.transliteration:
Karuna Sagara Hey Nandalala
Murali Manohara Shyama Gopala
Giridhara Naagara Sai Gopala
Meera Ke Prabhu Shyama Gopala
lyrics.translation: This devotional piece celebrates Lord Krishna as the son of Nanda, an ocean of mercy with the enchanting flute. The composition honors him as the lifter of Govardhana mountain and the Lord of Meera, the celebrated devotee.

lyrics.original:
साई बाबा सकल भुवन के दाता
रूप मनोहर कमल कान्त
युग अवतार साई बाबा दया करो पार्थी बाबा
शिर्डी पार्थी हृदय निवासी
प्रशान्ति सुन्दर साई
lyrics.transliteration:
Sai Baba Sakala Bhuvana Ke Daata
Roopa Manohara Kamala Kantha
Yuga Avatar Sai Baba Daya Karo Parthi Baba
Shirdi Parthi Hrudaya Nivasi
Prashanthi Sundara Sai
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Sai Baba, protector of the universe, with a form as beautiful as a lotus. Avatar of this age, shower your mercy upon us. You who reside in our hearts at Shirdi and Parthi, beautiful Lord of Prashanthi.

lines.original: साई बाबा सकल भुवन के दाता
lines.transliteration: Sai Baba Sakala Bhuvana Ke Daata

lyrics.original:
ईश्वराम्बा प्रिय तनय साई नारायण
साई नारायण सत्य नारायण
कलि युग में अवतार लिए
कण कण में तेरा नाम (हे साई)
lyrics.transliteration:
Eshwaramba Priya Tanaya Sai Narayana
Sai Narayana Sathya Narayana
Kali Yug Mey Avatar Liye
Kan Kan Mey Tera Naam (O Sai)
lyrics.translation: Beloved son of Mother Eshwaramba, you are Sai Narayana, Sathya Narayana. In the Kali age you took avatar — your name is present in every atom.

lyrics.original:
राम रहीम को भजनेवाले तेरे पुजारी बाबा
तेरा नाम एक सहारा
तुम ही हो गीता तुम ही रामायण
तुम ही हो वेद कुरान
lyrics.transliteration:
Ram Rahim Ko Bhajanewaale Terey Poojari Baba
Tera Naam Ek Sahara
Tum Hi Ho Geeta Tum Hi Ramayan
Tum Hi Ho Veda Quran
lyrics.translation: Devotees of both Lord Rama (Hindus) and Rahim (Islam) worship You, O Lord. Your name is our only refuge. You are the Bhagavad Gita, the Ramayana, the Vedas and the Quran — embodying sacred texts of all traditions.

lines.original: राम रहीम को भजनेवाले तेरे पुजारी बाबा
lines.transliteration: Ram Rahim Ko Bhajanewaale Terey Poojari Baba

lines.original: तुम ही हो गीता तुम ही रामायण
lines.transliteration: Tum Hi Ho Geeta Tum Hi Ramayan

lyrics.original:
जय जय जय हे मधुसूधन
जय बृन्दावन मन मोहन
सुन्दर साई शिर्डी पार्थी विहारी
राधे श्याम राधे श्याम
साई राम साई राम
lyrics.transliteration:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey Madhusudhana
Jaya Brindavana Mana Mohana
Sundara Sai Shirdi Parthi Vihari
Radhey Shyam Radhey Shyam
Sai Ram Sai Ram
lyrics.translation: Victory to Lord Krishna, slayer of the demon Madhu. Victory to the enchanting deity of Brindavan. Honoring beautiful Sai who dwells in Shirdi and Parthi — Radhey Shyam, Sai Ram.

lyrics.original:
वन्दे उमा नन्दनम् गजाननम्
सुरमुनि सेवित सुमुख गजाननम्
विद्या दायक बुद्धि प्रदायक
सिद्धि विनायक पाहि गजाननम्
lyrics.transliteration:
Vande Uma Nandanam Gajananam
Suramuni Sevitha Sumukha Gajananam
Vidya Dayaka Buddhi Pradayaka
Siddhi Vinayaka Paahi Gajananam
lyrics.translation: Salutations to the elephant-faced son of Uma (Parvati), worshipped by sages. Bestower of knowledge, intellect and boons — protector and remover of obstacles, please save us.

lyrics.original:
गुरुवर नाम पावन नाम
सद्गुरु नाम गुरु नानक नाम
गुरुवर नाम पावन नाम
सद्गुरु साई बाबा नाम
जय गुरु सद्गुरु नानक नाम जय बोलो साई बाबा नाम
lyrics.transliteration:
Guruvara Naam Pavana Naam
Sadguru Naam Guru Nanak Naam
Guruvara Naam Pavana Naam
Sadguru Sai Baba Naam
Jai Guru Sadguru Nanak Naam Jai Bolo Sai Baba Naam
lyrics.translation: Sing the holy names of the Guru — Guru Nanak and Sai Baba. These names purify the heart and elevate the spirit.

lyrics.original:
नन्दीश्वर हे नटराज नन्दात्मज हरि नारायण
नारायण हरि (साई) नारायण
नागभरण नमः शिवाय
नाद स्वरूप नमो नमो
lyrics.transliteration:
Nandeeshwara Hey Nataraja Nandatmaja Hari Narayana
Narayana Hari (Sai) Narayana
Nagabharana Namah Shivaya
Naada Swaroopa Namo Namo
lyrics.translation: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the master of Nandi and the cosmic dancer Nataraja. He is also Hari Narayana. Adorned with serpents — Namah Shivaya. Embodiment of divine sound — we bow again and again.

lines.original: नन्दीश्वर हे नटराज नन्दात्मज हरि नारायण
lines.transliteration: Nandeeshwara Hey Nataraja Nandatmaja Hari Narayana

lyrics.original:
भव सागर से पार उतारो
साई नाथ भगवान
अल्लाह येसु बुद्ध महावीर
सब नामों की एक है महिमा
सर्व धर्म के पालनहारे
lyrics.transliteration:
Bhava Sagar Se Paar Utharo
Sai Nath Bhagawan
Allah Yesu Buddha Mahavira
Sab Naamon Ki Ek Hai Mahima
Sarva Dharma Ke Palanhaarey
lyrics.translation: Lord Sai, lift us across the ocean of worldly existence. Allah, Jesus, Buddha, Mahavira — all these names share the same glory. You are the sustainer of all faiths.

lines.original: सब नामों की एक है महिमा
lines.transliteration: Sab Naamon Ki Ek Hai Mahima

lyrics.original:
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे गोपी गोप बाला
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे मुरली गान लोला
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे राधा रमण लोला
गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे नन्द गोप बाला
lyrics.transliteration:
Govinda Harey Gopala Harey Hey Gopi Gopa Bala
Govinda Harey Gopala Harey Hey Murali Gaana Lola
Govinda Harey Gopala Harey Hey Radha Ramana Lola
Govinda Harey Gopala Harey Hey Nanda Gopa Bala
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Krishna — Govinda and Gopala — surrounded by the gopis and gopas, enchanting with his flute, beloved of Radha, the cherished son of Nanda.

lines.original: गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे गोपी गोप बाला
lines.transliteration: Govinda Harey Gopala Harey Hey Gopi Gopa Bala

lines.original: गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे मुरली गान लोला
lines.transliteration: Govinda Harey Gopala Harey Hey Murali Gaana Lola

lines.original: गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे राधा रमण लोला
lines.transliteration: Govinda Harey Gopala Harey Hey Radha Ramana Lola

lines.original: गोविन्द हरे गोपाल हरे हे नन्द गोप बाला
lines.transliteration: Govinda Harey Gopala Harey Hey Nanda Gopa Bala

lyrics.original:
देवी साई मा देवी सरस्वती मा
दुर्गा भवानी मा काली कपालिनी मा
जगदोद्धारिणी मा
साई दया करो मा (सत्य)
lyrics.transliteration:
Devi Sai Ma Devi Saraswathi Ma
Durga Bhavani Ma Kaali Kapalini Ma
Jagadodharini Ma
Sai Daya Karo Ma
lyrics.translation: Mother Sai, Mother Saraswathi — Mother Durga, Mother Bhavani, Mother Kaali. Uplifter of the universe — shower compassion upon us, O Mother.

lines.original: देवी साई मा देवी सरस्वती मा
lines.transliteration: Devi Sai Ma Devi Saraswathi Ma

lines.original: दुर्गा भवानी मा काली कपालिनी मा
lines.transliteration: Durga Bhavani Ma Kaali Kapalini Ma

lyrics.original:
नारायण साई नारायण
मधुसूधन नारायण
हे शेष शयन नारायण
नारायण हरि साई नारायण
विट्ठल विट्ठल पाण्डुरङ्ग विट्ठल
विट्ठल विट्ठल पार्थी रङ्ग विट्ठल
विट्ठल विट्ठल साई रङ्ग विट्ठल
lyrics.transliteration:
Narayana Sai Narayana
Madhusudhana Narayana
Hey Shesha Shayana Narayana
Narayana Hari Sai Narayana
Vittala Vittala Panduranga Vittala
Vittala Vittala Parthi Ranga Vittala
Vittala Vittala Sai Ranga Vittala
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Vittala — verily Lord Narayana reclining on the celestial serpent Adi Sesha. He is Madhusudhana (Krishna) and Sai of Parthi — divine manifestations united in this sacred song.

lyrics.original:
ईश्वराम्बा नन्दन जगत् विधाता
पार्थी निवास साई देव दया करो गुरु देव
कमल नयन हे हृदय विहारी
आनन्द दायक हे गिरिधारी
चरण शरण में लेलो हम को
युग अवतार कृष्ण (साई) मुरारी
lyrics.transliteration:
Eshwaramba Nandana Jagat Vidhata
Parthi Nivasa Sai Deva Daya Karo Guru Deva
Kamala Nayana Hey Hrudaya Vihari
Ananda Dayaka Hey Giridhari
Charan Sharan Mey Lelo Hum Ko
Yuga Avatara Krishna (Sai) Murari
lyrics.translation: Son of Mother Eshwaramba, creator of the universe — Lord Sai who resides in Parthi, shower us with grace. Lotus-eyed dweller of our hearts, joy-giver, lifter of Govardhana — take us into your sacred refuge. Avatar of this age, Krishna and Sai.

lines.original: पार्थी निवास साई देव दया करो गुरु देव
lines.transliteration: Parthi Nivasa Sai Deva Daya Karo Guru Deva

lyrics.original:
पुण्य नाम पवित्र नाम राम नाम साई राम
हरे कृष्ण हरे राम मधुर (अमृत) नाम साई राम
करुणा सिन्धु सीता राम दीन बन्धु राधे श्याम
lyrics.transliteration:
Punya Naam Pavitra Naam Rama Naam Sai Ram
Harey Krishna Harey Ram Madhura (Amrutha) Naam Sai Ram
Karuna Sindhu Sita Ram Deena Bandhu Radhey Shyam
lyrics.translation: Pure and holy is the name of Lord Sai Rama — sweet and nectarine are the names of Krishna and Rama. Ocean of mercy, Sita Rama — friend of the dejected, Radhey Shyam.

lines.original: पुण्य नाम पवित्र नाम राम नाम साई राम
lines.transliteration: Punya Naam Pavitra Naam Rama Naam Sai Ram

lines.original: हरे कृष्ण हरे राम मधुर नाम साई राम
lines.transliteration: Harey Krishna Harey Ram Madhura Naam Sai Ram

lyrics.original:
श्री रामचन्द्र जय रामचन्द्र
रघुवीर रणधीर रघुकुल राम
दशरथ नन्दन दयाभि राम
दानव भञ्जन कोदण्ड राम
कल्याण राम कमनीय राम
lyrics.transliteration:
Sri Ramachandra Jaya Ramachandra
Raghuveera Ranadheera Raghukula Rama
Dasharatha Nandana Dayabhi Rama
Danava Bhanjana Kodanda Rama
Kalyana Rama Kamaneeya Rama
lyrics.translation: Glory to Sri Ramachandra — valiant warrior of the Raghu clan, beloved son of King Dasharatha, slayer of demons wielding the sacred bow Kodanda — auspicious and beautiful Lord Rama.

lyrics.original:
राधे गोविन्द गोपाल जय गोविन्द राधे गोपाल
गोविन्द गोविन्द गोपाल
कृष्ण मधुसूधन मधुसूधन कृष्ण
गोविन्द गोविन्द गोपाल (साई)
lyrics.transliteration:
Radhey Govinda Gopala Jaya Govinda Radhey Gopala
Govinda Govinda Gopala
Krishna Madhusudhana Madhusudhana Krishna
Govinda Govinda Gopala (Sai)
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Krishna — Govinda, Gopala, beloved of Radha. Slayer of the demon Madhu — through the sacred repetition of names, the heart finds devotion.

lines.original: राधे गोविन्द गोपाल जय गोविन्द राधे गोपाल
lines.transliteration: Radhey Govinda Gopala Jaya Govinda Radhey Gopala

lyrics.original:
हर शिव शंकर भोले नाथ शिर्डी पुरीश्वर साई नाथ
शिव शिव शंकर भोले नाथ पार्थी पुरीश्वर साई नाथ
फणि भूषण शिव गौरी नाथ
परम सुमंगल साई नाथ
गिरिजा रमण परमानन्द समाधिप्रिय गङ्गा नाथ
lyrics.transliteration:
Hara Shiva Shankara Bholey Nath Shirdi Pureeshwara Sai Nath
Shiva Shiva Shankara Bholey Nath Parthi Pureeshwara Sai Nath
Phani Bhooshana Shiva Gowri Nath
Parama Sumangala Sai Nath
Girija Ramana Paramananda Samadhipriya Ganga Nath
lyrics.translation: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the benevolent one — identified with Sai of Shirdi and Parthi. Adorned with serpents, consort of Goddess Gowri — supremely auspicious. Beloved of Girija, embodiment of bliss, lover of meditation, bearer of the sacred Ganges.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Parthi Ke Baba

lyrics.original:
शिर्डी के साई पार्थी के बाबा
तुम हो हमारे प्यारे साई बाबा
प्रेममय साई प्रेम प्रदाता
ईश्वराम्बा नन्दन जगत् परिपाल
पाप विनाशक परम कृपाल
lyrics.transliteration:
Shirdi Ke Sai Parthi Ke Baba
Tum Ho Hamarey Pyaarey Sai Baba
Premamaya Sai Prema Pradatha
Eshwaramba Nandana Jagat Paripala
Paapa Vinashaka Parama Krupala
lyrics.translation: Lord Sai of Shirdi and Parthi — you are our beloved Sai Baba. Embodiment of love, bestower of love. Beloved son of Mother Eshwaramba, sustainer of the universe. Destroyer of sins, supremely compassionate.

lines.original: शिर्डी के साई पार्थी के बाबा
lines.transliteration: Shirdi Ke Sai Parthi Ke Baba

lines.original: तुम हो हमारे प्यारे साई बाबा
lines.transliteration: Tum Ho Hamarey Pyaarey Sai Baba

lyrics.original:
पाहि गजानन दीनावन सिन्दूर वदन
श्रित जन पालन अम्बिका तनय अमरधीश्वर
अगणित गुण गण आनन्द दायक
साई गजानन ताताये
(सत्य) साई गजानन ताताये
lyrics.transliteration:
Paahi Gajanana Deenavana Sindhura Vadana
Shritha Jana Palana Ambika Tanaya Amaradheeshwara
Aganita Guna Gana Ananda Dayaka
Sai Gajanana Tataeyou
(Sathya) Sai Gajanana Tataeyou
lyrics.translation: Protect us, Lord Gajanana, refuge of the humble, bearer of the radiant countenance. Sustainer of those who surrender, son of Ambika, lord of the celestials — possessor of countless virtues, bestower of bliss. Sai Gajanana, dwell within us.

lines.original: श्रित जन पालन अम्बिका तनय अमरधीश्वर
lines.transliteration: Shritha Jana Palana Ambika Tanaya Amaradheeshwara

lyrics.original:
अल्लाह हो अकबर अल्लाह हो अकबर अल्लाह हो अकबर
येसु पिता प्रभु अल्लाह हो अकबर
शिर्डी साई पार्थी साई तुम हो
गुरु नानक भी तुम हो
जरथुस्त्र महावीर तुम हो
अल्लाह हो अकबर तुम हो साई
ला इलाहा इल अल्लाह मोहम्मदुर रसूल अल्लाह
lyrics.transliteration:
Allah Ho Akbar Allah Ho Akbar Allah Ho Akbar
Yesu Pitha Prabhu Allah Ho Akbar
Shirdi Sai Parthi Sai Tum Ho
Guru Nanak Bhi Tum Ho
Zohrashtra Mahavir Tum Ho
Allah Ho Akbar Tum Ho Sai
La Ilaha Il Allah Mohammadur Rasool Allah
lyrics.translation: Allah is the Supreme. He is also Jesus, Shirdi Sai, Parthi Sai, Guru Nanak, Zoroaster, and Mahavira — the divine essence united across Islam, Christianity, Sikhism, Zoroastrianism, and Jainism.

lines.original: अल्लाह हो अकबर अल्लाह हो अकबर
lines.transliteration: Allah Ho Akbar Allah Ho Akbar

lines.original: येसु पिता प्रभु अल्लाह हो अकबर
lines.transliteration: Yesu Pitha Prabhu Allah Ho Akbar

lines.original: शिर्डी साई पार्थी साई तुम हो
lines.transliteration: Shirdi Sai Parthi Sai Tum Ho

lyrics.original:
जगदीश्वरी दया करो मा
शिव शंकरी कृपा करो मा
सयीश्वरी रक्षा करो मा
पार्थीश्वरी भला करो मा
lyrics.transliteration:
Jagadeeshwari Daya Karo Ma
Shiva Shankari Krupa Karo Ma
Sayeeshwari Raksha Karo Ma
Partheeshwari Bhalaa Karo Ma
lyrics.translation: Mercy on us, O Mother Goddess of the Universe. May Your benedictions be upon us, O Shankari, consort of Lord Shiva. Shower Your blessings and protect us, O Sayeeshwari, the Goddess of Parthi.

lyrics.original:
बोलो बोलो सब मिल बोलो ॐ नमः शिवाय
जूटा जटा में गंगाधारी
त्रिशूल धारी डमरू बजावे
दम दम दम दम डमरू बजा
गूंज उठाओ ॐ नमः शिवाय
lyrics.transliteration:
Bolo Bolo Sab Mil Bolo Om Namah Shivaya
Joota Jata Mey Gangadhari
Trishoola Dhari Damaru Bajaavey
Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Bajaa
Goonj Utao Om Namah Shivaya
lyrics.translation: Call upon the Lord of All and chant Om Namah Shivaya to honor Lord Shiva. He holds the Holy Ganges in His matted locks of hair, wields the trident, and plays the kettle-drum. Let the chant echo throughout the universe.

lines.original: दम दम दम दम डमरू बजा
lines.transliteration: Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Bajaa

lyrics.original:
जय गुरु ओंकार जय जय सद्गुरु ओंकार ॐ
ब्रह्मा विष्णु सदाशिव
हर हर हर हर महादेव
शिव शिव शिव शिव सदाशिव
lyrics.transliteration:
Jaya Guru Omkara Jaya Jaya Sadguru Omkara Om
Brahma Vishnu Sadashiva
Hara Hara Hara Hara Mahadeva
Shiva Shiva Shiva Shiva Sadashiva
lyrics.translation: Salutations to our preceptor Sai, who is the form of the primordial sound Om — the creator Brahma, protector Vishnu, and destroyer Shiva. Honor to the embodiment of Mahadeva and Sadashiva.

lines.original: जय गुरु ओंकार जय जय सद्गुरु
lines.transliteration: Jaya Guru Omkara Jaya Jaya Sadguru

lyrics.original:
अन्तरंग साई अनाथ नाथ साई
दीन बन्धु साई करुणा सिन्धु साई
राम कृष्ण शिव शक्ति प्रेम रूप साई
युग अवतार बाबा श्री सत्य साई
lyrics.transliteration:
Antaranga Sai Anatha Natha Sai
Deena Bandhu Sai Karuna Sindhu Sai
Rama Krishna Shiva Shakthi Prema Roopa Sai
Yuga Avatara Baba Sri Sathya Sai
lyrics.translation: Lord Sai, dweller of the heart, protector of the orphaned. Friend of the dejected, ocean of compassion. Embodiment of Rama, Krishna, Shiva, Shakthi, and Supreme Love — the avatar of this age, Sri Sathya Sai Baba.

lines.original: दीन बन्धु साई करुणा सिन्धु साई
lines.transliteration: Deena Bandhu Sai Karuna Sindhu Sai

lines.original: राम कृष्ण शिव शक्ति प्रेम रूप साई
lines.transliteration: Rama Krishna Shiva Shakthi Prema Roopa Sai

lines.original: युग अवतार बाबा श्री सत्य साई
lines.transliteration: Yuga Avatara Baba Sri Sathya Sai

lyrics.original:
गौरी नन्दन गजानन
गंगाधर हर शम्भो नन्दन
परम सुमंगल मूषिक वाहन
गान विलोलन गजानन
lyrics.transliteration:
Gowri Nandana Gajanana
Gangadhara Hara Shambho Nandana
Parama Sumangala Mooshika Vahana
Gaana Vilolana Gajanana
lyrics.translation: O Lord Ganesha, the elephant-faced one, beloved son of Mother Gowri (Parvathi) and Lord Shiva who adorns the Ganges. You are supremely auspicious, who rides the mouse and revels in divine music.

lyrics.original:
श्री रघु नन्दन दशरथ नन्दन
भद्रदीश्वर राम
वैदेही प्रिय वैकुण्ठ वास
सदा स्मरामि रामेति राम
lyrics.transliteration:
Sri Raghu Nandana Dasharatha Nandana
Bhadradeeshwara Rama
Vaidehi Priya Vaikunta Vasa
Sada Smarami Ramethi Rama
lyrics.translation: Salutations to Lord Rama, son of the Raghu lineage, beloved son of King Dasharatha — the presiding deity of Bhadrachalam, beloved of Vaidehi (Sita), dweller of Vaikuntha. Let us incessantly chant his holy name.

lyrics.original:
शिर्डी साई द्वारकामायी प्रशान्ति वासी साई राम
साई राम साई राम एक नाम सुन्दर नाम
अल्लाह ईश्वर साई राम
पार्थीपुरी के हे भगवान
दया करो कृपा करो रक्षा करो हे भगवान
lyrics.transliteration:
Shirdi Sai Dwarakamayi Prashanthi Vasi Sai Ram
Sai Ram Sai Ram Ek Naam Sundara Naam
Allah Eshwara Sai Ram
Parthipuri Ke Hey Bhagawan
Daya Karo Krupa Karo Raksha Karo Hey Bhagawan
lyrics.translation: Salutations to Lord Shirdi Baba, dweller of Dwarakamayi and Prashanthi — Sai Ram, the name so enthralling. He is none other than Allah and Eshwar (Shiva), and the Lord of Parthi. Show mercy, shower grace, and protect us, O Lord.

lines.original: शिर्डी साई द्वारकामायी प्रशान्ति वासी साई राम
lines.transliteration: Shirdi Sai Dwarakamayi Prashanthi Vasi Sai Ram

lines.original: साई राम साई राम एक नाम सुन्दर नाम
lines.transliteration: Sai Ram Sai Ram Ek Naam Sundara Naam

lyrics.original:
शम्भो महादेव मल्लिकार्जुन
मंगल चरण त्रिलोचन
पिनाक पाणि पार्वती रमण
भव भय हरण सनातन
पार्थी पुरीश्वर पतित पावन
lyrics.transliteration:
Shambho Mahadeva Mallikarjuna
Mangala Charana Trilochana
Pinaka Paani Parvathi Ramana
Bhava Bhaya Harana Sanathana
Parthi Pureeshwara Patitha Pavana
lyrics.translation: Salutations at the sacred feet of Lord Shiva — Shambho, Mahadeva, and Mallikarjuna. Three-eyed one with auspicious feet, wielder of the Pinaka bow, consort of Parvathi. Destroyer of worldly fears, the eternal one — the Lord of Parthi and purifier of the fallen.

lyrics.original:
வா வா முருகையா வடிவேல் அழகா
கா வா வா குமார திரு கார்த்திகேயா
சிங்கார வேலா சிவ சக்தி பாலா
சங்கீத லோலா சத்ய சாயீசா
lyrics.transliteration:
Va Va Murugaiyya Vadivel Azhaga
Ka Va Va Kumara Thiru Karthikeya
Singara Vela Shiva Shakthi Bala
Sangeeta Lola Sathya Sayeesha
lyrics.translation: Come, O beautiful Lord Muruga, bearer of the divine spear. Protect us, Lord Karthikeya, the youthful son of Shiva and Shakthi. Bearer of the sacred spear, beloved son of Shiva and Shakthi — you are verily Lord Sathya Sai, who delights in divine music.

lines.original: கா வா வா குமார திரு கார்த்திகேயா
lines.transliteration: Ka Va Va Kumara Thiru Karthikeya

lyrics.original:
महा गणपते नमोस्तुते मतंग वदन नमोस्तुते
आदि पूजित गणनाथ आनन्द दायक गणनाथ
प्रथम वन्दन प्रणवाकार
विघ्नेश्वर विनायक
lyrics.transliteration:
Maha Ganapathey Namostuthey Matanga Vadana Namostuthey
Adi Poojita Gananatha Ananda Dayaka Gananatha
Prathama Vandana Pranavakara
Vighneshwara Vinayaka
lyrics.translation: Pranaams to the elephant-faced Lord of the Ganaas, who receives the first prayer, who is the giver of bliss, the embodiment of Pranava Om, and destroyer of obstacles in the path of spiritual practice.

lines.original: महा गणपते नमोस्तुते मतंग वदन नमोस्तुते
lines.transliteration: Maha Ganapathey Namostuthey Matanga Vadana Namostuthey

lines.original: आदि पूजित गणनाथ आनन्द दायक गणनाथ
lines.transliteration: Adi Poojita Gananatha Ananda Dayaka Gananatha

lyrics.original:
बाल गोपाल साई बाल गोपाल
देवकी नन्दन गोपाल
वसुदेव नन्दन गोपाल
यशोदा नन्दन गोपाल
नन्द गोपाल आनन्द गोपाल
साई गोपाल सत्य साई गोपाल
lyrics.transliteration:
Bala Gopala Sai Bala Gopala
Devaki Nandana Gopala
Vasudeva Nandana Gopala
Yashoda Nandana Gopala
Nanda Gopala Ananda Gopala
Sai Gopala Sathya Sai Gopala
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Bala Gopala (young Krishna), the beloved son of Mother Devaki and Vasudeva, fostered by Mother Yashoda and Nanda. He is the bestower of bliss — verily Lord Sathya Sai.

lyrics.original:
क्षीराब्धि शयन नारायण श्री लक्ष्मी रमण नारायण
नरहरि रूप नारायण
वैकुण्ठ वास नारायण वैदेही मोहन नारायण
नतजन परिपाल नारायण
lyrics.transliteration:
Ksheerabdhi Shayana Narayana Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana
Narahari Roopa Narayana
Vaikunta Vasa Narayana Vaidehi Mohana Narayana
Natajana Paripala Narayana
lyrics.translation: Chant the name of Lord Narayana who reclines on the Ocean of Milk, consort of Sri Lakshmi. He incarnated as Narasimha (Narahari), resides in Vaikuntha, charms Vaidehi (Sita), and takes care of those who surrender to Him.

lines.original: क्षीराब्धि शयन नारायण श्री लक्ष्मी रमण नारायण
lines.transliteration: Ksheerabdhi Shayana Narayana Sri Lakshmi Ramana Narayana

lines.original: वैकुण्ठ वास नारायण वैदेही मोहन नारायण
lines.transliteration: Vaikunta Vasa Narayana Vaidehi Mohana Narayana

lyrics.original:
प्रातः स्मरणं श्री गुरु चरणं
सयीश चरणं श्री गुरु चरणं
ब्रह्मानन्द प्रदायक चरणं
शरणं शरणं सयीश चरणं
lyrics.transliteration:
Prathah Smaranam Sri Guru Charanam
Sayeesha Charanam Sri Guru Charanam
Brahmananda Pradayaka Charanam
Sharanam Sharanam Sayeesha Charanam
lyrics.translation: Meditate at dawn upon the holy feet of the Guru, the lotus feet of Sai. Refuge of refuges — the feet that bestow eternal bliss. We surrender at the sacred feet of Lord Sai.

lyrics.original:
जय पाण्डुरङ्ग प्रभो विट्ठल
जगदोद्धार हरि विट्ठल
पाण्डुरङ्ग विट्ठल पण्डरी नाथ विट्ठल
श्री रमणी हृदयान्त रङ्ग
मंगल कर करुणान्त रङ्ग
आश्रित दीन जनावन रङ्ग
lyrics.transliteration:
Jaya Panduranga Prabho Vittala
Jagadodhara Hari Vittala
Panduranga Vittala Pandari Natha Vittala
Sri Ramani Hrudayanta Ranga
Mangala Kara Karunanta Ranga
Aashritha Deena Janavana Ranga
lyrics.translation: Victory to Lord Panduranga Vittala, the Lord of Pandharpur and liberator of the world. Lord Ranga dwells in the heart of His consort Mother Lakshmi — auspiciousness personified, most compassionate, and the bestower of grace upon the destitute.

lyrics.original:
सत्यं ज्ञानं अनन्तं ब्रह्म
सत्यं ब्रह्म ज्ञानं ब्रह्म अनन्तं ब्रह्म
lyrics.transliteration:
Sathyam Gnanam Anantham Brahma
Sathyam Brahma Gnanam Brahma Anantham Brahma
lyrics.translation: Glory to You, O Lord Sai, who is verily the Supreme Being — the embodiment of Eternal Truth, Wisdom, and the Infinite. You are Brahma, the ultimate spiritual reality.

lines.original: सत्यं ब्रह्म ज्ञानं ब्रह्म अनन्तं ब्रह्म
lines.transliteration: Sathyam Brahma Gnanam Brahma Anantham Brahma

lyrics.original:
ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ
शिव शिव हर हर हराय नमः ॐ
हर हर शिव शिव शिवाय नमः ॐ
हर हर महादेव हर हर महादेव
दम दम दम दम डमरू बाजे
धिमिथक धिमिथक मृदङ्ग बाजे
lyrics.transliteration:
Om Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Om
Shiva Shiva Hara Hara Haraya Namah Om
Hara Hara Shiva Shiva Shivaya Namah Om
Hara Hara Mahadeva Hara Hara Mahadeva
Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Baajey
Dhimithaka Dhimithaka Mrudanga Baajey
lyrics.translation: Salutations to Lord Shiva, the bestower of auspiciousness and destroyer of evil. Glory to Mahadeva who performs the cosmic dance, playing the Damaru and keeping time with the Mrudanga.

lines.original: ॐ नमः शिवाय शिवाय नमः ॐ
lines.transliteration: Om Namah Shivaya Shivaya Namah Om

lines.original: शिव शिव हर हर हराय नमः ॐ
lines.transliteration: Shiva Shiva Hara Hara Haraya Namah Om

lines.original: हर हर महादेव हर हर महादेव
lines.transliteration: Hara Hara Mahadeva Hara Hara Mahadeva

lines.original: दम दम दम दम डमरू बाजे
lines.transliteration: Dama Dama Dama Dama Damaru Baajey

lyrics.original:
गणपति ॐ जय गणपति ॐ
गजमुख वरद गणपति ॐ
मूषिक वाहन गजानन
मोदक हस्त गजानन
परम निरंजन गजानन
पाद नमस्ते गजानन
lyrics.transliteration:
Ganapathi Om Jaya Ganapathi Om
Gajamukha Varada Ganapathi Om
Mooshika Vahana Gajanana
Modaka Hasta Gajanana
Parama Niranjana Gajanana
Paada Namasthey Gajanana
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Ganesha, the elephant-faced one, bestower of boons. He rides the mouse, holds the modaka (sweet) in his hand. Supremely pure — we offer our salutations at His lotus feet.

lyrics.original:
मन्दिर में तुम राम हो साई
मस्जिद में नूर मोहम्मद (अल्लाह हो अकबर)
गुरुद्वारे में तुम गुरु नानक
मन मन्दिर में साई साई
बोलो राम एक ही नाम
सब मिल बोलो साई राम
lyrics.transliteration:
Mandir Mey Tum Ram Ho Sai
Masjid Mey Noor Mohammad
Gurudware Mey Tum Guru Nanak
Man Mandir Mey Sai Sai
Bolo Ram Ek Hi Naam
Sab Mil Bolo Sai Ram
lyrics.translation: You are adored as Ram in the Temple, as the light of Mohammad in the mosque, as Guru Nanak in the Gurudwara, and in the temple of my mind you are Sai. Chant the one name of Ram — let us all chant Sai Ram together.

lines.original: मन्दिर में तुम राम हो साई
lines.transliteration: Mandir Mey Tum Ram Ho Sai

lyrics.original:
घन घन नील वदन अति सुन्दर
मेघ श्यामल माधव मुरहर
मन्द स्मित मुख राधा मनोहर
गोविन्द गोपाल नटवर गिरिधर
lyrics.transliteration:
Ghana Ghana Neela Vadana Ati Sundara
Megha Shyamala Madhava Murahara
Mandasmitha Mukha Radha Manohara
Govinda Gopala Natavara Giridhara
lyrics.translation: Lord Krishna has a beautiful dark blue complexion like a rain cloud. He slayed the demon Mura, has a gentle smile, and is the enchanter of Radha — Govinda, Gopala, supreme dancer and lifter of Govardhana mountain.

lines.original: घन घन नील वदन अति सुन्दर
lines.transliteration: Ghana Ghana Neela Vadana Ati Sundara

lyrics.original:
शंकर शिव शंकर शिव शंकर
शंकर शिव शंकर शिव शंकर शम्भो
शंकर शिव शंकर शिव शम्भो महादेव
दम दम डमरू बजे शंकर घन घन घन्ट बजे
हर भोले नाथ शम्भो हर साई नाथ शम्भो
lyrics.transliteration:
Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shankara
Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shankara Shambho
Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shambho Mahadeva
Dama Dama Damaru Bajey Shankara Ghana Ghana Ghanta Bajey
Hara Bholey Natha Shambho Hara Sai Natha Shambho
lyrics.translation: Salutations to Lord Shankara, Shiva, Shambho — who dances to the rhythm of Damaru and the ringing of bells. Chant the name of Sai Natha who is verily Lord Shiva, the benevolent one.

lines.original: शंकर शिव शंकर शिव शंकर शम्भो
lines.transliteration: Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shankara Shambho

lines.original: शंकर शिव शंकर शिव शम्भो महादेव
lines.transliteration: Shankara Shiva Shankara Shiva Shambho Mahadeva

lines.original: हर भोले नाथ शम्भो हर साई नाथ शम्भो
lines.transliteration: Hara Bholey Natha Shambho Hara Sai Natha Shambho

lyrics.original:
साई माता पिता दीन बन्धु सखा
तेरे चरणों में साई मेरा कोटि प्रणाम
मुझे शक्ति दो मेरे साई शिव
मुझे भक्ति दो मेरे साई शिव
मुझे मुक्ति दो मेरे साई शिव
lyrics.transliteration:
Sai Mata Pitha Deena Bandhu Sakha
Terey Charanon Mey Sai Mera Koti Pranam
Mujhey Shakthi Do Merey Sai Shiva
Mujhey Bhakthi Do Merey Sai Shiva
Mujhey Mukthi Do Merey Sai Shiva
lyrics.translation: Lord Sai — you are my mother, father, friend of the forlorn, and companion. A million prostrations at your lotus feet. Grant me strength, devotion, and liberation, O Sai Shiva.

lines.original: साई माता पिता दीन बन्धु सखा
lines.transliteration: Sai Mata Pitha Deena Bandhu Sakha

lines.original: तेरे चरणों में साई मेरा कोटि प्रणाम
lines.transliteration: Terey Charanon Mey Sai Mera Koti Pranam

lines.original: मुझे शक्ति दो मेरे साई शिव
lines.transliteration: Mujhey Shakthi Do Merey Sai Shiva

lines.original: मुझे भक्ति दो मेरे साई शिव
lines.transliteration: Mujhey Bhakthi Do Merey Sai Shiva

lyrics.original:
मन एक बार हरि बोल
हरि हरि बोल हरि बोल
हरि पिता हरि माता
हरि गुरु ज्ञान दाता
चिदानन्द रूप हरि पतित पावन मन एक बार हरि बोल
lyrics.transliteration:
Man Ek Baar Hari Bol
Hari Hari Bol Hari Bol
Hari Pitha Hari Mata
Hari Guru Gnana Daata
Chidananda Roopa Hari Patitha Pavana Man Ek Baar Hari Bol
lyrics.translation: O Mind, chant the name of Lord Hari at least once. He is the Mother, Father, Preceptor and the one who bestows wisdom — the embodiment of awareness and bliss, redeemer of the downtrodden.

title: Jaya Sai Guru Deva Sai Guru Deva

lyrics.original:
जय साई गुरु देव साई गुरु देव
गुरु सेवा बिना निर्वाण नहीं जय साई गुरु देव
तुम ही हो माता पिता तुम ही हो साई गुरु देव
सत्य स्वरूप राह दिखाओ साई गुरु देव
lyrics.transliteration:
Jaya Sai Guru Deva Sai Guru Deva
Guru Seva Bina Nirvana Nahin Jaya Sai Guru Deva
Tum Hi Ho Mata Pitha Tum Hi Ho Sai Guru Deva
Sathya Swaroopa Raaha Dikhao Sai Guru Deva
lyrics.translation: There is no salvation without service to the Guru. Lord Sai, you are my mother and father. Embodiment of Truth — grace me with your guidance.

lines.original: जय साई गुरु देव साई गुरु देव
lines.transliteration: Jaya Sai Guru Deva Sai Guru Deva

lines.original: तुम ही हो माता पिता तुम ही हो साई गुरु देव
lines.transliteration: Tum Hi Ho Mata Pitha Tum Hi Ho Sai Guru Deva

lines.original: सत्य स्वरूप राह दिखाओ साई गुरु देव
lines.transliteration: Sathya Swaroopa Raaha Dikhao Sai Guru Deva

lyrics.original:
बड़ा चित्त चोर बृन्दावन संचार
गोपाल गोपाल हे मुरली गोपाल
गोवर्धनोद्धार गोपाल बाला
गोपी मनोहर राधे गोपाल
lyrics.transliteration:
Bada Chitha Chora Brindavana Sanchara
Gopala Gopala Hey Murali Gopala
Govardhanodhara Gopala Bala
Gopi Manohara Radhey Gopala
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Krishna — the great stealer of hearts who roamed in Brindavan, lifter of Govardhana mountain, enchanter of the gopis and beloved of Radha.

lyrics.original:
तुम हो दाता साई शंकर
हम को दीजो आनन्द बाबा
आओ शंकर अनाथ नाथ
दीजो दर्शन दीन नाथ
lyrics.transliteration:
Tum Ho Daata Sai Shankara
Hum Ko Deejo Ananda Baba
Aao Shankara Anatha Natha
Deejo Darshana Deena Natha
lyrics.translation: Lord Sai, who is verily Lord Shiva, you are the bestower of all. Grant us eternal bliss. Come, Shankara — protector of the orphaned. Bless us with your darshan, Lord of the destitute.

lyrics.original:
हे ब्रह्मा हे विष्णु
दयामय हे महेश्वर
सत्य साई परमेश्वर
महा शक्ति शिव साई शंकर
पूर्ण तेज साई अवतार
lyrics.transliteration:
Hey Brahma Hey Vishnu
Dayamaya Hey Maheshwara
Sathya Sai Parameshwara
Maha Shakthi Shiva Sai Shankara
Poorna Teja Sai Avatara
lyrics.translation: Salutations to Lord Sathya Sai who embodies the trinity — Brahma the creator, Vishnu the preserver, and Maheshwara the dissolver. Supreme Sovereign full of compassion, the total incarnation of Supreme Energy.

lyrics.original:
हे माधव हे मधुसूधन
दामोदर हे मुरलीधर
मन मोहन हे यदु नन्दन
दीनावन भव भय भञ्जन
lyrics.transliteration:
Hey Madhava Hey Madhusudhana
Damodara Hey Muralidhara
Mana Mohana Hey Yadu Nandana
Deenavana Bhava Bhaya Bhanjana
lyrics.translation: Glory to Lord Madhava, slayer of the demon Madhu, holder of the flute. Damodara, enchanter of hearts, son of the Yadu dynasty — protector of the downtrodden, destroyer of worldly fears.

lyrics.original:
गजवदन गणनाथ
गौरी तनय दयामय
भुवनाधार प्रणव स्वरूप
पालय पालय पार्थी पुरीश
lyrics.transliteration:
Gajavadana Gananatha
Gowri Tanaya Dayamaya
Bhuvanaadhara Pranava Swaroopa
Palaya Palaya Parthi Pureesha
lyrics.translation: O Lord Ganesha, elephant-faced Lord, son of Mother Parvathi — supremely compassionate. Embodiment of Pranava (Om) and basis of all creation. Protect us, O Sai, Lord of Parthi.
